malkinStoredSeries.query: select player_id,strength_state,game_date,updated_at,season_games_played,games_played,toi_seconds_avg_season,pp_points_avg_season,pp_toi_seconds_avg_season from public.rolling_player_game_metrics where season=20252026 and strength_state='all' and player_id in(8478402,8471215,8477934) and game_date<='2026-04-16' order by player_id,game_date desc limit 12
malkinStoredSeries.note: The initial shared limit returned only player 8471215. The per-player comparison below independently covers all three requested IDs. This series projection retains date, update time and stored GP from the returned rows.

malkinSourceCutoffs.query: with cutoffs(cutoff)as(values('2026-03-05'::date),('2026-03-16'::date),('2026-04-12'::date)) select c.cutoff,count(w.*)as source_rows,count(distinct w.game_id) as source_game_ids,min(w.date) as first_source_date,max(w.date) as last_source_date,count(*) filter(where w.toi_per_game>0)as positive_toi_rows,sum(w.pp_points)as pp_points_sum,sum(w.pp_toi)as pp_seconds_sum from cutoffs c left join public.wgo_skater_stats w on w.player_id=8471215 and w.season_id=20252026 and w.date<=c.cutoff group by c.cutoff order by c.cutoff

storedVersusCurrentSources.query: with requested(player_id)as(values(8471215),(8478402),(8477934)) select r.player_id,p."fullName" as player_name,r.game_date,r.updated_at,r.games_played,r.season_games_played,r.toi_seconds_avg_season,r.pp_points_avg_season,r.pp_toi_seconds_avg_season,s.source_rows,s.source_game_ids,s.first_source_date,s.positive_toi_rows,s.pp_points_present,s.pp_toi_present,s.pp_points_sum,s.pp_seconds_sum from requested q join lateral(select player_id,game_date,updated_at,games_played,season_games_played,toi_seconds_avg_season,pp_points_avg_season,pp_toi_seconds_avg_season from public.rolling_player_game_metrics where player_id=q.player_id and season=20252026 and strength_state='all' and game_date<='2026-04-16' order by game_date desc limit 1)r on true left join public.players p on p.id=r.player_id join lateral(select count(*) as source_rows,count(distinct game_id) as source_game_ids,min(date) as first_source_date,count(*)filter(where toi_per_game>0)as positive_toi_rows,count(pp_points)as pp_points_present,count(pp_toi)as pp_toi_present,sum(pp_points)as pp_points_sum,sum(pp_toi)as pp_seconds_sum from public.wgo_skater_stats where player_id=r.player_id and season_id=20252026 and date<=r.game_date)s on true order by r.player_id

malkinPpSourcePriority.query: select count(*)as joined_rows,count(distinct w.game_id)as source_game_ids,count(p."PPTOI")as builder_pp_toi_present,count(*)filter(where p."PPTOI" is null and w.pp_toi is not null)as wgo_fallback_rows,sum(w.pp_toi)as wgo_pp_seconds_sum,sum(coalesce(p."PPTOI",w.pp_toi))as selected_pp_seconds_sum from public.wgo_skater_stats w left join public."powerPlayCombinations" p on p."playerId"=w.player_id and p."gameId"=w.game_id where w.player_id=8471215 and w.season_id=20252026 and w.date<='2026-04-12'
malkinPpSourcePriority.note: The current writer prefers powerPlayCombinations.PPTOI and falls back to WGO pp_toi, so its PP denominator is not the WGO-only sum. The dry-run average 181.910714 times GP 56 reproduces 10,187 seconds within rounding precision.

pittsburghStoredSchedule.query: select g.type,count(*) as stored_scheduled_games,min(g.date)as first_date,max(g.date)as last_date from public.games g join public.teams t on t.id=g."homeTeamId" or t.id=g."awayTeamId" where t.abbreviation='PIT' and g."seasonId"=20252026 and g.date<='2026-04-12' group by g.type order by g.type
pittsburghStoredSchedule.note: These sum to the dry-run team denominator 88. The inspected ledger does not filter game type. Schedule counts do not certify completed-game or player-appearance coverage.
